## Summary

The root cause of the pandas import failure was that all Python source files (`.py`) in the `/testbed/pandas` directory had been renamed to `.bak` files. This caused `ModuleNotFoundError` when trying to import pandas because Python couldn't find the source modules.

The fix was straightforward: restore all the `.bak` files by removing the `.bak` extension, effectively renaming them back to `.py` files. The compiled bytecode files (`.pyc`) in the `__pycache__` directories were still present, which helped identify the issue.

After restoring the files, all tests pass successfully.
